content: Inter-ECU transmission of composite data without Data Trans- formation Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00028 For inter-ECU transmission of composite data type where • a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping to the VariableDataProto- type is defined • and the respective ISignalGroup has no comBasedSignalGroupTrans- formation defined the RTE shall invoke Com_SendSignal for each ISignal to which an element in the composite data type is mapped and Com_SendSignalGroup for each ISignal- Group to which the composite data element is mapped.
